events.title: Former 동커스터 로버스 chairman Ken Richardson is sentenced to four years in prison for paying a friend to start a fire at the club's Belle Vue ground in 1995. The arsonist, 41-year-old Alan Kristiansen, receives a one-year prison sentence, while two other men receive suspended sentences for their part in the fire, which caused £100,000 worth of damage.

맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 0–0 with 첼시 in the FA Cup quarter-final at Old Trafford, with 폴 스콜스 being sent off for United and Roberto Di Matteo for 첼시 in a game which kicked off just hours after the death was announced of legendary former United striker Dennis Viollet from cancer at age 65.
Dwight Yorke keeps 맨체스터 유나이티드 in line for the treble as he scores both their goals in the 2–0 quarter-final replay win at 첼시.
애스턴 빌라 sign midfielder Steve Stone from 노팅엄 포리스트 for £5.5 million.
노팅엄 포리스트 keep their faint survival hopes alive with a 3–1 away win over 윔블던, only their third league win of the season.
New J.League Division 2 (J2) season started with ten clubs, one relegated from previous season's J.League and nine promoted from former Japan Football League .

반즐리, the only non-Premier League team to reach the FA Cup quarter-finals, bow out at Oakwell when David Ginola scores the only goal of the game for 토트넘 홋스퍼, who remain in contention for a cup double .
The Monopolies and Mergers Commission vetoes BSkyB's takeover of 맨체스터 유나이티드.
토트넘 홋스퍼 end their eight-year wait for a major trophy (and European qualification) thanks to a 1–0 win over 레스터 시티 in the League Cup final .
블랙번 로버스 pay 더비 카운티 £3.4 million for midfielder Lee Carsley .

March ends with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the Premier League by a four-point margin, with 아스널 and 첼시 as their nearest contenders. 리즈 유나이티드, occupying fourth place, are still within a shout of the league title. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 complete the top five, competing with most of the rest of the "safe" Premier League teams for a UEFA Cup place. 노팅엄 포리스트's dreadful run of form has continued and they now need a miracle to escape relegation. 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 사우샘프턴 complete the bottom three. 선덜랜드 are now 12 points ahead of their nearest rivals 입스위치 타운 at the top of Division One. 브래드퍼드 시티, 버밍엄 시티 and 볼턴 원더러스 remain in the playoff zone, where they are joined by a 울버햄프턴 원더러스 side whose form is continuing to improve.
